name: @reduxjs/toolkit
description: The official, opinionated, batteries-included toolset for efficient Redux development
author: Mark Erikson <mark@isquaredsoftware.com>

scripts.build-ci: yarn rimraf dist && yarn tsc && yarn lint && node scripts/cli.js --skipExtraction
scripts.build: yarn rimraf dist && yarn tsc && node scripts/cli.js --local --skipExtraction
scripts.build-only: yarn rimraf dist && yarn tsc && node scripts/cli.js --skipExtraction
scripts.type-tests: yarn tsc -p src/tests/tsconfig.typetests.json && yarn tsc -p src/query/tests/tsconfig.typetests.json
